method: Signed-in paginated accepted, revision and pending views plus a direct lookup for TK-J987L9. Review window applied to reviewed_at. Screened titles and checked the setup, instructions and scoring of mechanically related entries.
defining_motion: Fold a laptop hinge from its open typing angle through flat, then transfer the load from both hands to the two front edges with the display facing outward.

comparisons.title: Move an open, running laptop from a stack of books to its stand without holding it by the screen
comparisons.comparison: Transfers an open ThinkPad from books to a separate stand. Its scorer caps the lid motion at 25 degrees and rejects lid contact. The convertible task rotates its hinge through flat and stands the two case edges directly on the desk.

comparisons.title: Stand a folded birthday card on a shelf as a tent: turn it crease-up by its front leaf and set both edges down open
comparisons.comparison: Shares the edge-supported tent silhouette. The 13.5 g card turns crease-up and spreads its two light leaves around a springy crease. The laptop folds a loaded friction hinge from typing through flat while the robot supports both panels.

comparisons.title: Stand a tablet by unfolding its attached back support
comparisons.comparison: Unfolds a tablet kickstand into a support. The laptop task moves its display and keyboard chassis through the shared 360-degree hinge and loads both full-width front rims.

comparisons.title: Clear the clutter off a laptop, then open it
comparisons.comparison: Safely opens a conventional laptop lid after moving clutter. The chassis must stay flat. The convertible task lifts and reorients the chassis and transfers support onto the rims.

comparisons.title: Fold a travel hair dryer's handle
comparisons.comparison: Folds a travel hair dryer handle 80 to 93 degrees against its barrel for storage. The object rests on the counter after folding.

comparisons.title: Unfold a child's folding step stool: lift each end, push its leg out until its own lock clicks, stand it on its feet
comparisons.comparison: Unfolds and locks two step-stool legs before setting the stool on its feet under a load. The laptop balances on its two case edges with a passive hinge.

comparisons.title: Set up a folded tabletop easel with its rear leg out at the hinge stop, then rest a canvas on its ledge
comparisons.comparison: Swings an easel rear leg to a hinge stop, stands its three feet and places a separate canvas on the ledge.
